text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to settle Q4 runtime OKR scope. Two big asks from GTM: (1) 3x embeddings throughput target for Dedicated, (2) <2s p95 for chat on 4k/8k models. How much of this is kernels vs infra vs KV cache? :thinking:

 dmitri: My short take: kernels + KV cache yield the largest latency wins. Quant helps cost but introduces risk for accuracy; also sometimes hurts latency for short sequences.

 jess: FWIW AcmeCorp escalated — they want p95 <2s on 4k seq at 500 req/s. They'll sign Dedicated if we can commit SLA.

 mike: Tradeoffs: to hit p95 we can reduce batching (worse cost/unit) or aggressively pre-warm KV and keep smaller batches. Pre-warm increases GPU memory and node count.

 sam: Proposed OKR split: OKR1: p95 <2s (4k) for top-3 models on Dedicated. OKR2: cost/unit -20% via targeted int8 quant + smarter batching rules. Keep quant as gated opt-in.

 elaine: Draft launch criteria: (a) 24h p95 test under prod-like traffic (b) eval suite shows no significant quality regressions (c) canary rollout path with auto-fallback. Add anything?

 jess: +1 to eval SLI. We should include automated regression alerts tied to prompt sets. If quant causes >1% BLEU/ROUGE drop for a model class, block rollout.

 dmitri: Rough dev estimates: attn kernel optimizations ~6w, fused-GEMM paths ~4w, KV prefix caching + smarter eviction ~4w. Quant infra (safe rollout hooks) ~5w. These can overlap but core kernel work needs focused sprint time.

 mike: Ops note: Canaries require reserved capacity — ops suggests reserve 20% pool or a separate small Dedicated cluster. Ballpark cost delta: `~$14k/mo` for reserve.

 runtime-bot: checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/RT-Q4-kernels-kv (owner: elaine) :white_check_mark:

 ben: If we prioritize kernels+KV this quarter we should deprioritize broad quant rollout — keep quant as experimental feature for a small set of customers. That reduces risk for SLAs.

 elaine: Decision (tentative): prioritize kernels + KV for Q4 OKR; treat quant as opt-in/experimental and move broad rollout to Q1. Action items: 1) dmitri to triage kernel tasks and break into tickets; 2) ben to confirm capacity/cost impact; 3) jess to prepare eval suites and regression thresholds; 4) mike to draft SLA language for Dedicated. I'll capture in the roadmap doc after this thread.

 jess: ping @dmitri — can you post the initial perf numbers from the bench run by EOD?

 dmitri: running benches now on rtx-cluster; initial numbers show 18% p95 improvement with prefix KV on 4k seq for the small-model set. Will post full table shortly.

 mike: thanks — if numbers hold we can justify the customer SLA. Also suggest adding a micro-OKR for fallback policies (model-variant routing) so app stays online when quant or kernel path fails.

 elaine: Agreed. We'll add routing fallback to the launch criteria. I'll update OKR doc and drop a short roadmap note.

 dmitri: posted bench results: `4k_seq_no_kv p95=1.9s | with_prefix_kv p95=1.56s | batch=16` — attaching more later.

 jess: looks good. I'll start assembling the eval harness for AcmeCorp prompts.

 ben: ops confirmed reserve estimate, and a path for burst pools. I'll attach costing in the roadmap PR.

 elaine: Great. End state: kernels+KV prioritized for launch target in 6–8 weeks for MVP, canary plan ready, quant remains gated. Thanks all.
